hardening.purpose: real Servo retained-node behavior regressions on a file-disjoint test-only patch stage; production action-advertisement enforcement is contained in the base stage

source_invariants: route a non-root AccessKit TreeId to exactly one current WebView
bind the request again to the WebView current active top-level PipelineId
reject root, stale, missing, ambiguous, inactive, unsupported, disabled and retained nodes without finalized layout bounds
resolve NodeId only from the current retained AccessibilityTree at the active embedder epoch
advertise Click only for the initial reviewed native button surface
require the exact retained AccessKit node to advertise the requested action before dispatch
refresh the retained tree and resolve the DOM node inside one script-thread task
dispatch only one untrusted click event to the resolved node
never fall back to coordinates, JavaScript evaluation, WebDriver or text search
return one typed terminal result through a GenericCallback

separately identified prospective-merge checkout and parent-order assertion
exact upstream commit and AccessKit ABI verification
base-patch, hardening-patch and combined digest verification
production verify-d3-patch CLI invocation executed by the repository regression suite
no post-format path outside the allowlist
real Servo retained-node positive, stale, disabled, hidden, non-element, unsupported-data and dropped-callback regressions
actual closure branch trigger and every transitive qualification source
carrier base commit ancestry and live pull-request base equality
complete base plus hardening application in the prospective merge job
post-format tested Servo patch digest and staged tree identity
post-behavior byte-for-byte tested patch and tree revalidation
prospective merge complete changed-path equality and tested-tree evidence artifact

claim_ceiling: A green exact-head workflow proves clean complete-package application and the bounded retained-node corpus on the recorded post-format Servo tree in Servo's real test harness. A green prospective-merge job proves the live synthetic merge retains the same complete base-plus-hardening package, allowed changed paths, patch digest and staged Servo tree. Neither proves installed Trillionnium BrowserActor/receipt integration, independent image replay, release eligibility, physical hardware, protected-environment approval or HSM signing.
